name: Vern
source:
Vern is the youngest of the brothers. He’s actually a friendly guy, but he’s too shy to show it at first. Like his oldest brother though, he likes jokes and funny punch lines. A lot. At first he didn’t want Cara Lee’s presence in his home, but he warms up to her, eventually.

(Taken from [url=https://ainoshiki.wordpress.com/games/once-upon-a-hallows-eve/]dev page[/url])
